criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark and bold in value structure; 1, 6 and 9 hold a real west key. More than one frame falls short: the kit Hereford reads as a plastic toy on 1, 6 and 8; frame 5's section faces render flat navy and the dunnage reads as one slab; frame 4 has steers in a file along the alley, two pools and labels on plates; frame 6's near throat shows a dark curled flap; frame 2's bunk is a thin strip; 7 and 8 sit on a muddy purple-grey field.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world: the bunk and rail through 1, 2, 4 to 9 under one west key, and both devices work. Frame 3 is a flat grid and 7 and 8 shift to a purple-grey field.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and frame 3 measures true. Four phrasings run looser: frame 4's kicker says feed alleys are planned, frame 6's headline drops 'estimated' on a 30 thousand head margin, frame 6's isotype can't be checked at feed size, and frame 9's 'a plan' firms up 'can be evaluated'. c17 to c20 are medium confidence.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where are clear and frame 6 gives the Panhandle stake. No county, no deciding body beyond USDA, and the close gives nothing to do; the record's public_access reaches no frame.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 7 turns. Frame 8 restates and frame 6 could move.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and regionally specific with no rule breaks. 'Drawn to illustrate' recurs on nine of nine, and frame 9's two short sentences read as a disclaimer.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The first feedlot deck in the window, but lastLight again, a kit person at the close again, a precast object again, an absence spine again and a university release instrument again.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frames 8, 4 and 5 in-camera: a haired steer close-up on near black over the lit windrow, cattle out of the feed alley, and the section's long face in its concrete material under the key.

artwork_weakest_frames.change: A haired hide material, a tight key pool on the face so the field drops to near black, and the bunk lip and windrow across the bottom third.
Seat the steers inside the lit pens, collapse to one pool on one commercial pen and its two partners, and drop the label plates.
Give the section's long and inner faces the concrete material under the key, and make the dunnage two separate timbers with their own contact shadows.
Move the long lens closer so the sections fill the middle third and bleed both edges.
Drop the field to near black, bring the bunk lip and throat into the lower third, and set the quote at 24 px or more.
Light the windrow along the near throat in place of the dark flap, and make the 5-of-22 divider read in the pool.
